text.zh_cn: 这本手册描述完整的法阵链路：画布上的像素如何变成符文，符文如何组成法阵，法阵如何被编译成可运行的操作。它同时也是开发者视角的体系索引。
text.en_us: This manual follows the complete array pipeline: pixels become glyphs, glyphs become arrays, and arrays compile into executable operations. It is also a developer-facing index of the system.

items.zh_cn: 画布保存颜色层、魔力效果层和编译缓存。
items.en_us: Canvas data stores colors, mana effect layers, and compile caches.

items.zh_cn: 服务端从连通像素提取 glyph，并用模板识别符文。
items.en_us: The server extracts connected glyphs and recognizes them with templates.

items.zh_cn: 外环把内部 glyph 组织成可嵌套的语法树。
items.en_us: An outer circle organizes inner glyphs into a nestable syntax tree.

items.zh_cn: 编译器匹配操作定义，生成实体、元素和投影运行时。
items.en_us: The compiler matches operation definitions and creates entity, element, and projection runtimes.

text.zh_cn: 第一次实验不要从复杂法术开始。先让识别器看见一个稳定的魔力笔画，再逐层增加外环、中心符文和参数符文。每次只改变一个变量，排错会快得多。
text.en_us: Do not begin with a complex spell. First give the recognizer one stable mana stroke, then add the boundary, center, and parameter runes one layer at a time. Change one variable per experiment.

text.zh_cn:
空白画布 → 魔力笔画 → 可识别 glyph
        → 外环 + 中心符文 → 有效法阵
        → 操作符文/嵌套法阵 → 编译运行时
text.en_us:
blank canvas -> mana stroke -> recognized glyph
              -> boundary + center -> valid array
              -> op runes/nested arrays -> runtime

text.zh_cn: 手册中反复出现的几个词有严格含义。理解这些名称，就能读懂日志、网络包和编译诊断。
text.en_us: Several terms have precise meanings throughout the manual. Knowing them makes logs, packets, and compiler diagnostics much easier to read.

items.zh_cn: Glyph：从画布连通像素提取出的单个图形。
items.en_us: Glyph: one connected shape extracted from canvas pixels.

items.zh_cn: Boundary：外环 glyph，负责限定内部范围。
items.en_us: Boundary: an outer-circle glyph that scopes inner content.

items.zh_cn: CenterSymbol：一个法阵的中心行为或类型。
items.en_us: CenterSymbol: the center behavior or type of an array.

items.zh_cn: ParameterRune：传给中心或操作编译器的参数。
items.en_us: ParameterRune: a parameter supplied to a center or compiler.

items.zh_cn: OpInput：编译器看到的 rune、已编译操作或原始子法阵。
items.en_us: OpInput: a rune, compiled operation, or raw child array seen by the compiler.

items.zh_cn: CompiledOp：带边界、输入和运行时行为的可执行节点。
items.en_us: CompiledOp: an executable node with a boundary, inputs, and runtime behavior.

items.zh_cn: ArrayObject：服务端保存的活动法阵及其反向索引。
items.en_us: ArrayObject: the server-side live array and its reverse indexes.

text.zh_cn: 基础工作流需要画布、笔、墨水瓶和圆规。它们不是四种独立的魔法系统：笔读取副手墨水，画布承载图形，圆规帮助绘制边界。
text.en_us: The basic workflow uses a canvas, pen, ink bottle, and compass. They are one system: the pen reads the offhand ink, the canvas stores the glyphs, and the compass helps draw boundaries.

items.zh_cn: 画布：放置后成为可编辑的实体表面，也能被收进物品或法杖。
items.en_us: Canvas: a placeable, editable surface that can be packed into an item or wand.

items.zh_cn: 笔：主手绘制器，画笔尺寸和步进来自 PenProperties。
items.en_us: Pen: the main-hand painter; brush size and step come from PenProperties.

items.zh_cn: 魔力墨水：副手的颜色与 gyromancy:mana 效果来源。
items.en_us: Mana ink: the offhand source of color and the gyromancy:mana effect.

items.zh_cn: 圆规：绘制受半径控制的圆或弧，并能保存一支笔。
items.en_us: Compass: draws a radius-controlled circle or arc and can store a pen.

text.zh_cn: InkBottleItem 并不把颜色写死在物品类里。瓶子保存 ink_type 和 ink_remaining，笔在每次绘制时解析自定义墨水注册表。
text.en_us: InkBottleItem does not hard-code a color. The bottle stores ink_type and ink_remaining; the pen resolves the custom ink registry while painting.

text.zh_cn:
INK_TYPE      -> gyromancy:mana_ink
INK_REMAINING  -> 64 charges by default
PenProperties  -> brush size / precision / speed
Paint effect   -> gyromancy:mana + ink effect keys
text.en_us:
INK_TYPE      -> gyromancy:mana_ink
INK_REMAINING  -> 64 charges by default
PenProperties  -> brush size / precision / speed
Paint effect   -> gyromancy:mana + ink effect keys

items.zh_cn: 没有墨水瓶、没有 ink_type 或剩余量为零时，笔返回空颜色，不会绘制。
items.en_us: Without a bottle, ink_type, or remaining charges, the pen returns no color and paints nothing.

items.zh_cn: 默认每十次有效绘制动作消耗一次墨水，减少网络与耐久噪声。
items.en_us: By default one charge is consumed per ten valid paint actions.

text.zh_cn: 铜粒合成铜环。铜环是可雕刻材料，也是印章和法杖配方中的结构部件。符文雕刻台提供一次性的输入—输出雕刻流程，不保存自己的库存。
text.en_us: Copper nuggets craft into copper rings. Rings are carvable components used by the stamp and wand recipes. The Rune Carving Table performs an input-to-output carving flow and has no persistent inventory of its own.

items.zh_cn: 印章保存一份 CanvasDocument，而不是只保存识别后的符文列表。
items.en_us: A Stamp stores a CanvasDocument, not just a list of recognized runes.

items.zh_cn: CarvingProperties 决定材料颜色、效果层和分辨率缩放。
items.en_us: CarvingProperties define the material color, effect layer, and resolution scale.

items.zh_cn: 配方中的 carving ingredient 能检查外环和指定符文序列。
items.en_us: A carving ingredient can check an outer circle and an ordered rune sequence.

text.zh_cn: 画布的核心不是一个纹理文件，而是可同步、可编辑、可编译的数据文档。放置画布实体时，文档随实体保存；收回或放入法杖时，文档随物品保存。
text.en_us: A canvas is not merely a texture. It is a synchronized, editable, compilable document. When placed, the document lives on the canvas entity; when packed or stored in a wand, it travels with the item.

text.zh_cn:
physicalWidth / physicalHeight  -> 世界表面尺寸
resolutionScale              -> 每格像素密度
colors[]                     -> ARGB 颜色层
strokeEffects[]              -> mana / symbol / glyph 效果层
glyphs + compiledAst           -> 识别与编译缓存
text.en_us:
physicalWidth / physicalHeight  -> world surface size
resolutionScale              -> pixels per block
colors[]                     -> ARGB color layer
strokeEffects[]              -> mana / symbol / glyph layers
glyphs + compiledAst           -> recognition and compile caches

text.zh_cn: Painter API 负责把笔的 PaintPattern 写到表面；Gyromancy 再用效果层判断哪些像素能进入法阵识别。颜色看起来正确，并不等于它是魔力像素。
text.en_us: The Painter API writes a pen's PaintPattern to the surface. Gyromancy then uses effect layers to decide which pixels enter recognition. A pixel that looks correct is not necessarily a mana pixel.

items.zh_cn: 主手拿笔，按住使用键，且必须命中画布表面。
items.en_us: Hold the pen in the main hand, hold use, and hit the canvas surface.

items.zh_cn: PenItem 用距离门限制重复采样；StampItem 使用自己的步进。
items.en_us: PenItem gates repeated samples by distance; StampItem uses its own step.

items.zh_cn: 编辑器中的左键绘制、右键擦除；Shift 平移/缩放视图。
items.en_us: In the editor, left draws and right erases; Shift pans or zooms the view.

items.zh_cn: 撤销、重做和清除只改变编辑历史，提交时才发送完整快照。
items.en_us: Undo, redo, and clear change edit history; the complete snapshot is submitted at the end.

label.en_us: Why color alone is not enough

text.zh_cn: 画布编辑采用客户端预览、服务端校验和受影响画布同步的路径。这样能让动态纹理即时反馈，又避免客户端直接决定法阵状态。
text.en_us: Canvas editing uses a client preview, server validation, and affected-canvas synchronization path. The dynamic texture feels immediate while the server remains authoritative over array state.

items.zh_cn: SubmitCanvasEditPacket 提交变更，服务端按修订版本处理。
items.en_us: SubmitCanvasEditPacket sends changes and the server checks the revision.

items.zh_cn: Glyph 和编译缓存属于可重建数据；底层颜色与效果层才是事实来源。
items.en_us: Glyphs and compile caches are rebuildable; colors and effect layers are the source of truth.

items.zh_cn: 画布物品、印章和法杖都携带文档的副本，因此可以复制实验结果。
items.en_us: Canvas items, stamps, and wands carry document copies so experiments can be reproduced.

text.zh_cn: 符文识别从 gyromancy:mana 效果层开始。ManaPixelDetector 不会把任意不透明颜色当成笔画；没有魔力效果层的图像即使可见，也会被识别管线忽略。
text.en_us: Recognition starts from the gyromancy:mana effect layer. ManaPixelDetector does not treat every opaque color as a stroke; visible pixels without the mana effect are ignored.

items.zh_cn: 墨水的 manaValue 写入每个笔刷覆盖像素。
items.en_us: The ink's manaValue is written to every covered brush pixel.

items.zh_cn: 其他 effectKeys 可为未来的元素墨水、标记或过滤器提供扩展点。
items.en_us: Additional effectKeys leave room for elemental inks, markers, and filters.

items.zh_cn: 擦除必须同时清除颜色和效果，否则视觉与识别状态会分离。
items.en_us: Erasing must clear both color and effects or visual and recognition state diverge.

caption.zh_cn: 魔力中心模板 / Mana template
caption.en_us: 魔力中心模板 / Mana template

text.zh_cn: 服务端从种子像素进行 flood fill，得到跨画布边界的连通 glyph。随后 SymbolRecognizer 把 glyph 的骨架、端点、环和方向特征交给 SkeletonMatcher。
text.en_us: The server flood-fills from mana seeds and extracts connected glyphs across canvas boundaries. SymbolRecognizer then gives the glyph skeleton, endpoints, loops, and orientation features to SkeletonMatcher.

items.zh_cn: 一个断开的笔画可能被分成多个 glyph；相互粘连的两个符文可能被当成一个 glyph。
items.en_us: A broken stroke may become several glyphs; two touching runes may become one glyph.

items.zh_cn: 每个模板拥有自己的软阈值和 allowRotation 设置。
items.en_us: Each template has its own soft thresholds and allowRotation setting.

items.zh_cn: 匹配结果带有 confidence、边界框、朝向和 SymbolRole。
items.en_us: A match carries confidence, bounds, orientation, and SymbolRole.

caption.zh_cn: 高阈值外环 / Strict boundary template
caption.en_us: 高阈值外环 / Strict boundary template

text.zh_cn: 识别只是第一关。GlyphMarker 会把 symbol_id 写回画布效果层，MagicArrayManager 保存位置和关系；InteriorValidator 再按包围盒判断哪些 glyph 属于哪个外环。
text.en_us: Recognition is only the first gate. GlyphMarker writes symbol_id back to the canvas effect layer, MagicArrayManager stores positions and relations, and InteriorValidator uses bounding boxes to decide which glyphs belong to a boundary.

items.zh_cn: OUTER_CIRCLE：法阵边界，可嵌套。
items.en_us: OUTER_CIRCLE: a nestable array boundary.

items.zh_cn: CENTER_SYMBOL：法阵中心，第一阶段必须恰好一个。
items.en_us: CENTER_SYMBOL: the array center; stage one requires exactly one.

items.zh_cn: PARAMETER_RUNE：中心符文或操作定义的输入。
items.en_us: PARAMETER_RUNE: input to a center or operation definition.

items.zh_cn: 0 个中心或 2 个以上中心会拒绝成阵，不会创建 ArrayObject。
items.en_us: Zero or multiple centers reject the array and no ArrayObject is created.

text.zh_cn: 修改画布时，受影响 glyph 会进入重新验证队列。若某个已绑定 glyph 被破坏，数组的结束效果先执行，反向索引清理后，剩余 glyph 仍可被新外环重新组织。
text.en_us: When a canvas changes, affected glyphs enter a revalidation queue. If a bound glyph is damaged, the array end effect runs first; after reverse indexes are cleaned, surviving glyphs can be organized by a new boundary.

text.zh_cn:
canvas edit
  -> affected blocks
  -> glyph revalidation
  -> array register / teardown
  -> canvas + glyph sync
text.en_us:
canvas edit
  -> affected blocks
  -> glyph revalidation
  -> array register / teardown
  -> canvas + glyph sync

items.zh_cn: GlyphChunkStorage 负责跨区块保存 glyph 关系。
items.en_us: GlyphChunkStorage keeps glyph relations across chunks.

items.zh_cn: 客户端只渲染同步到的 glyph overlay；服务端状态优先。
items.en_us: The client renders synchronized glyph overlays; the server state is authoritative.

text.zh_cn: 当前模板注册表包含 20 个内置图形。不要只按外观猜作用：角色决定它能否作为边界、中心或参数进入后续编译。
text.en_us: The built-in template registry currently contains 20 shapes. Do not infer behavior from appearance alone: the role decides whether a glyph can be a boundary, center, or parameter.

text.zh_cn:
外环：circle_outer
中心：dark earth fire mana space star water wind
参数：arrow arrow_up cross curl drain eliminate engaging fix
       loop revert split
text.en_us:
boundary: circle_outer
centers: dark earth fire mana space star water wind
parameters: arrow arrow_up cross curl drain eliminate engaging fix
             loop revert split

text.zh_cn: 中心符文决定法阵的语义入口，但最终效果通常由其内部的操作树决定。Fire、Water 和 Mana 已经有直接运行时协作；Earth、Wind 等还可作为编译结构的语义中心。
text.en_us: A center rune is the semantic entry point of an array, but the final effect usually comes from the operation tree inside it. Fire, Water, and Mana already have direct runtime integration; Earth and Wind also serve as semantic compilation centers.

items.zh_cn: mana：只接受 arrow 参数时会生成 Manaball；箭头数量影响发射数据。
items.en_us: mana: with arrow parameters it launches a Manaball; arrow count affects launch data.

items.zh_cn: fire：火球体系的中心模板，通常与 FireProjectileOp 组合。
items.en_us: fire: the fireball center template, commonly combined with FireProjectileOp.

items.zh_cn: water：水弹与碰撞触发体系的中心模板。
items.en_us: water: the center for water projectiles and collision-triggered behavior.

items.zh_cn: wind / star：允许旋转的模板，适合方向和局部坐标实验。
items.en_us: wind / star: rotation-capable templates suited to direction and local-frame experiments.

items.zh_cn: dark / earth / space：中心角色已注册；具体效果取决于组合的操作定义。
items.en_us: dark / earth / space: registered center roles whose effects depend on matched operation definitions.

text.zh_cn: 参数符文不一定独立产生效果。它们可能被某个 OpDefinition 直接匹配，也可能只是进入中心符文的 ParameterRune 列表。
text.en_us: Parameter runes do not always produce an effect on their own. An OpDefinition may match them directly, or they may simply become a center's ParameterRune list.

items.zh_cn: arrow：常用方向输入；MomentumOp 用它计算投射方向和大小。
items.en_us: arrow: a common direction input; MomentumOp uses it for projectile direction and size.

items.zh_cn: arrow_up：SplitEmitOp 可用法阵面法线作为向上发射方向。
items.en_us: arrow_up: SplitEmitOp can use the array face normal as an upward emission direction.

items.zh_cn: engaging：ElementOp 的入口，后续可接受 mana/fire/water/earth/wind 等元素符文。
items.en_us: engaging: the ElementOp entry point, accepting elemental runes such as mana, fire, water, earth, and wind.

items.zh_cn: split：把一个发射路径分成多路；drain / eliminate / fix / revert 参与数据语义。
items.en_us: split: divides an emission path; drain, eliminate, fix, and revert participate in data semantics.

items.zh_cn: cross / curl / loop：通用形状参数或持久化结构的输入，是否生效取决于匹配器。
items.en_us: cross, curl, and loop are general shape or persistence inputs whose effect depends on the matcher.

text.zh_cn: 每个 Symbol 都关联一份 PNG 模板和一组 SkeletonMatcher 阈值。资源文件是识别事实的一部分，修改图形时必须同步检查训练样本、旋转设置和测试图片。
text.en_us: Each Symbol points to a PNG template and a set of SkeletonMatcher thresholds. The resource file is part of recognition truth; changing a shape requires checking samples, rotation settings, and test images.

text.zh_cn:
src/main/resources/assets/gyromancy/textures/symbol/*.png
src/test/resources/test_images/symbol/*.png
ModSymbols -> Symbol -> SymbolTemplate -> SkeletonMatcher
text.en_us:
src/main/resources/assets/gyromancy/textures/symbol/*.png
src/test/resources/test_images/symbol/*.png
ModSymbols -> Symbol -> SymbolTemplate -> SkeletonMatcher

items.zh_cn: allowRotation=false 的模板必须按固定朝向绘制。
items.en_us: Templates with allowRotation=false must be drawn in their expected orientation.

items.zh_cn: confidence 只是匹配信号，空间关系和魔力层仍然必须正确。
items.en_us: Confidence is only a match signal; mana layers and spatial relations must still be correct.

text.zh_cn: ArrayAstBuilder 从外环开始构建 GroupNode。外环内部的直接子节点按角色变成 SymbolNode 或新的 GroupNode，因此法阵可以把一个完成的子法阵当作父法阵的输入。
text.en_us: ArrayAstBuilder starts from an outer circle and builds a GroupNode. Direct children become SymbolNodes or nested GroupNodes by role, allowing a finished child array to become input to a parent array.

text.zh_cn:
GroupNode(boundary)
  └─ SequenceNode(children)
       ├─ SymbolNode(parameter)
       ├─ SymbolNode(center)
       └─ GroupNode(nested boundary)
text.en_us:
GroupNode(boundary)
  └─ SequenceNode(children)
       ├─ SymbolNode(parameter)
       ├─ SymbolNode(center)
       └─ GroupNode(nested boundary)

items.zh_cn: 子节点先经过包围盒和有效笔画筛选。
items.en_us: Children are filtered by bounds and valid strokes first.

items.zh_cn: 嵌套结构允许 Projection、Emit 或组合操作消费另一个法阵。
items.en_us: Nesting lets projection, emission, and composition operations consume another array.

text.zh_cn: OpDefinition 不是硬编码的 if-else 链，而是声明 match、accepted 和 compile。ScopedCompiler 会从当前作用域的输入中寻找最长、最具体的组合。
text.en_us: An OpDefinition is not a hard-coded if-else chain. It declares match, accepted, and compile; ScopedCompiler searches the current scope for the longest and most specific combination.

items.zh_cn: rune(name)：匹配指定符文，例如 arrow 或 engaging。
items.en_us: rune(name): matches a named rune such as arrow or engaging.

items.zh_cn: op(type)：匹配已编译的子操作，例如 MomentumOp。
items.en_us: op(type): matches a compiled child operation such as MomentumOp.

items.zh_cn: boundary(role)：匹配带指定边界角色的子操作。
items.en_us: boundary(role): matches a child operation with a boundary role.

items.zh_cn: rawGroup(role)：只匹配编译失败、仍保持原始形态的子法阵。
items.en_us: rawGroup(role): matches a failed child group that remains raw.

text.zh_cn:
match   = 必须同时出现的输入
accepted = 可被同一操作吸收的附加输入
compile = 把匹配结果变成 CompiledOp
text.en_us:
match   = required inputs
accepted = additional inputs the op may consume
compile = turns the match into a CompiledOp

text.zh_cn: 编译成功后，CompiledArray 保存根操作、根边界、绑定 glyph 和颜色。失败不会静默消失：CompileDiagnostic 会指出缺失输入、冲突组合或无法消费的符文。
text.en_us: On success, CompiledArray stores the root operation, root boundary, bound glyphs, and color. Failure is not silent: CompileDiagnostic reports missing inputs, conflicting combinations, or unconsumed runes.

items.zh_cn: CompiledOp 的 inputs 是后续运行时的结构化参数，不是原始像素。
items.en_us: CompiledOp.inputs are structured runtime parameters, not raw pixels.

items.zh_cn: EntityPayload 统一把持久化、实体 tick 和丢弃回调挂到运行时。
items.en_us: EntityPayload unifies persistence, entity ticks, and discard callbacks.

items.zh_cn: 编译颜色来自操作或中心符文，用于 glyph overlay 的可视反馈。
items.en_us: Compile colors come from an operation or center and drive glyph overlay feedback.

text.zh_cn: 法阵由服务端维护。创建时保存 GlyphChunkStorage 和 ArrayObject，激活中心效果；任一绑定 glyph 失效时，先调用 EndEffect，再取消注册并同步受影响画布。
text.en_us: The server owns array state. Creation stores the glyph in GlyphChunkStorage and ArrayObject, then activates the center effect. When any bound glyph fails, EndEffect runs before unregistering and syncing affected canvases.

text.zh_cn:
register glyphs -> validate interior -> compile AST
                  -> activate center / runtime
canvas edit -> revalidate -> teardown or rebuild
text.en_us:
register glyphs -> validate interior -> compile AST
                  -> activate center / runtime
canvas edit -> revalidate -> teardown or rebuild

items.zh_cn: LoopOp、ProjectionOp 等持久化操作需要在 server tick 中维护。
items.en_us: Persistent operations such as LoopOp and ProjectionOp are maintained on server ticks.

items.zh_cn: TriggerOp 在事件或碰撞条件满足时触发一次性行为。
items.en_us: TriggerOp fires one-shot behavior when an event or collision condition is met.

text.zh_cn: 当前代码中的操作定义覆盖投射、元素、运动、发射、触发和持久化。它们通过 @RegisteredOp 自动发现并进入 OpDefinitionRegistry。
text.en_us: The current operation set covers projectiles, elements, motion, emission, triggers, and persistence. @RegisteredOp discovery places definitions into OpDefinitionRegistry automatically.

items.zh_cn: ElementOp / ElementConversionOp / ElementVolumeOp：吸收、转换和影响元素浓度。
items.en_us: ElementOp / ElementConversionOp / ElementVolumeOp: absorb, convert, and affect element concentrations.

items.zh_cn: FireProjectileOp / WaterProjectileOp / ManaProjectileOp / IlluminationOp：生成不同球体或光照实体。
items.en_us: FireProjectileOp / WaterProjectileOp / ManaProjectileOp / IlluminationOp: create projectile or illumination entities.

items.zh_cn: MomentumOp / SplitEmitOp / ProjectionOp：计算运动、分裂发射和画布投影。
items.en_us: MomentumOp / SplitEmitOp / ProjectionOp: calculate motion, split emission, and canvas projection.

items.zh_cn: ExplosionOp / SmeltOp / BrewingOp / CarryItemsOp：对方块、物品和炼制流程施加效果。
items.en_us: ExplosionOp / SmeltOp / BrewingOp / CarryItemsOp: affect blocks, items, and brewing flows.

items.zh_cn: FollowingOp / RotationOp / LoopOp：跟随、旋转和循环 tick 行为。
items.en_us: FollowingOp / RotationOp / LoopOp: follow, rotate, and repeat tick behavior.

items.zh_cn: TriggerOp / WaterBurstOp / OnDiscardOp / RemoveOnHitOp：事件、碰撞和清理回调。
items.en_us: TriggerOp / WaterBurstOp / OnDiscardOp / RemoveOnHitOp: events, collisions, and cleanup callbacks.

text.zh_cn: 投射操作先从法阵的 SurfaceFrame、方向符文和速度输入得到发射姿态，再把结果交给对应实体。实体的生命周期由 EntityPayload 和 PersistentOp 协作管理。
text.en_us: Projectile operations derive a launch pose from the array SurfaceFrame, direction runes, and velocity inputs, then hand it to the matching entity. EntityPayload and PersistentOp manage its lifecycle.

items.zh_cn: MomentumOp 负责方向、箭头数量、大小和速度等几何输入。
items.en_us: MomentumOp handles direction, arrow count, size, and velocity geometry.

items.zh_cn: Fire/Water/Mana projectile 使用各自实体和渲染器，效果不只是一种粒子。
items.en_us: Fire, Water, and Mana projectiles use distinct entities and renderers, not only particles.

items.zh_cn: OnEntityTickOp 在服务端 tick 运行；客户端只接收同步后的可视状态。
items.en_us: OnEntityTickOp runs on server ticks; the client receives synchronized visual state.

caption.zh_cn: 实体效果示意 / Entity effect
caption.en_us: 实体效果示意 / Entity effect

text.zh_cn: 一次性操作和持续操作的边界很重要。触发操作在条件出现时调用 trigger；持久化操作必须注册到世界状态或 tick 集合，并在法阵解体时解除。
text.en_us: The boundary between one-shot and persistent operations matters. Trigger operations call trigger when a condition occurs; persistent operations register with world state or tick sets and unregister when the array ends.

text.zh_cn:
PersistentOp.activate -> register(level)
PersistentOp.deactivate -> unregister(level)
TriggerOp.shouldTrigger -> trigger(context)
OnDiscard -> release entities / data
text.en_us:
PersistentOp.activate -> register(level)
PersistentOp.deactivate -> unregister(level)
TriggerOp.shouldTrigger -> trigger(context)
OnDiscard -> release entities / data

items.zh_cn: LoopOp 的循环表会随世界 tick 更新，避免每个实体重复创建调度器。
items.en_us: LoopOp updates a world tick table instead of creating a scheduler per entity.

items.zh_cn: RemoveOnHit 和 WaterBurst 等操作把碰撞当成触发边界。
items.en_us: RemoveOnHit and WaterBurst treat collisions as trigger boundaries.

text.zh_cn: 添加操作时优先实现清晰的 OpDefinition 和 Codec，再让运行时类只处理执行。注册表会扫描 com.astune.gyromancy.compile.operator 下带 @RegisteredOp 的类。
text.en_us: When adding an operation, define a clear OpDefinition and Codec first, then keep execution inside the runtime class. The registry scans @RegisteredOp classes under com.astune.gyromancy.compile.operator.

items.zh_cn: ID 必须稳定且命名空间为 gyromancy，避免存档和缓存失效。
items.en_us: IDs must be stable and use the gyromancy namespace to protect saves and caches.

items.zh_cn: match 要尽量具体，accepted 用于声明可吸收的附加输入。
items.en_us: Keep match specific; use accepted to declare consumable extra inputs.

items.zh_cn: 失败返回 CompileResult.Failure，并提供可读诊断，不要用 null 表示失败。
items.en_us: Return CompileResult.Failure with readable diagnostics; do not use null for failure.

text.zh_cn: 世界中的每个元素单元格保存九种浓度：八种元素加原始魔力。元素不是一次性物品，而是会受生物群系、扩散和法阵操作影响的场。
text.en_us: Each world cell stores nine concentrations: eight elements plus raw Mana. Elements are not one-shot items; they form a field affected by biomes, flow, and array operations.

text.zh_cn:
WIND  FIRE  WATER  EARTH
LIGHT DARK  SPACE  TIME
MANA = 通用魔力 / universal magical energy
text.en_us:
WIND  FIRE  WATER  EARTH
LIGHT DARK  SPACE  TIME
MANA = universal magical energy

items.zh_cn: 风：移动与速度；火：破坏与热；水：流体与湿润环境。
items.en_us: Wind: motion and speed; Fire: destruction and heat; Water: fluids and wet environments.

items.zh_cn: 土：稳定与地下；光：净化与治疗；暗：虚空与阴影。
items.en_us: Earth: stability and underground; Light: purification and healing; Dark: void and shadows.

items.zh_cn: 空间：存储与维度；时间：速度和时间尺度；魔力：所有法术的原料。
items.en_us: Space: storage and dimensions; Time: speed and time scale; Mana: the raw input for magic.

text.zh_cn: ElementTile 把世界切成 8×8×8 的密集小块。只有活跃单元占用存储；每个单元拥有值、导数、待处理通量和六面阻挡信息。
text.en_us: ElementTile divides the world into dense 8×8×8 tiles. Only active cells consume storage; each cell has values, derivatives, pending flux, and six blocked faces.

items.zh_cn: ElementChunkData 挂在区块上，ElementChunkEventHandler 管理加载与卸载。
items.en_us: ElementChunkData lives on chunks; ElementChunkEventHandler manages load and unload.

items.zh_cn: ElementChunkProcessor 处理扩散、回归和区块内的元素通量。
items.en_us: ElementChunkProcessor handles diffusion, regression, and flux inside chunks.

items.zh_cn: 屏障刷新会读取方块面，防止元素穿过阻挡面。
items.en_us: Barrier refresh reads block faces to stop elements crossing blocked sides.

items.zh_cn: 调试同步每十 tick 发送快照，便于客户端绘制浓度覆盖层。
items.en_us: Debug synchronization sends snapshots every ten ticks for the client concentration overlay.

text.zh_cn: ElementOp 以 engaging 为入口，可从内部符文推断要吸收的元素；它从法阵外圈吸收浓度，并按目标体积把魔力释放到内部。
text.en_us: ElementOp enters through engaging and can infer the absorbed element from inner runes. It drains concentration outside the array and releases Mana into the interior based on target volume.

items.zh_cn: ElementConversionOp 消耗法阵内部的 MANA，并按 interval 转换成指定元素。
items.en_us: ElementConversionOp drains interior MANA and converts it to a chosen element on an interval.

items.zh_cn: ElementVolumeOp 用元素体积影响空间范围或球体体积。
items.en_us: ElementVolumeOp uses element volume to affect spatial or projectile volume.

items.zh_cn: 操作在服务端运行，避免客户端和服务器对浓度产生分歧。
items.en_us: These operations run on the server so concentration cannot diverge between sides.

text.zh_cn:
engaging + fire  -> ElementOp(absorbedElement = FIRE)
engaging + water -> ElementOp(absorbedElement = WATER)
MANA in volume  -> ElementConversionOp(target, interval)
text.en_us:
engaging + fire  -> ElementOp(absorbedElement = FIRE)
engaging + water -> ElementOp(absorbedElement = WATER)
MANA in volume  -> ElementConversionOp(target, interval)

text.zh_cn: 圆规不是外环识别器本身，而是一个精确的绘制工具。它用 compass_radius 数据组件保存半径，用 compass_pen 保存可选的笔。
text.en_us: The compass is not the recognizer itself; it is a precision drawing tool. It stores its radius in compass_radius and an optional pen in compass_pen.

items.zh_cn: Shift+滚轮调整半径，客户端立即显示半径提示并同步到服务端。
items.en_us: Shift+scroll changes radius; the client shows a radius overlay and syncs it to the server.

items.zh_cn: 按住右键并转动视角，在命中表面绘制圆或弧。
items.en_us: Hold right-click and turn your view to draw a circle or arc on the hit surface.

items.zh_cn: 圆规可以减少外环断裂，但仍必须使用带 mana 效果的墨水。
items.en_us: The compass reduces broken boundaries, but it still needs ink with the mana effect.

text.zh_cn: 印章先在本地编辑器中保存图案，再把图案作为 PaintPattern 写回画布。Shift+右键进入编辑器，左键盖印，右键擦除，R 旋转，X+拖动缩放。
text.en_us: A stamp first stores a pattern in its local editor, then writes it back as a PaintPattern. Shift+right-click opens the editor; left applies, right erases, R rotates, and X+drag resizes.

items.zh_cn: StampCanvasMaterial 决定刻痕颜色和效果值。
items.en_us: StampCanvasMaterial decides the carved color and effect value.

items.zh_cn: 印章的版本号用于服务端拒绝旧快照覆盖新图案。
items.en_us: The stamp revision prevents an old snapshot from overwriting a newer pattern.

items.zh_cn: 印章可以复制结构，但不会自动解决符文识别或法阵空间关系。
items.en_us: A stamp copies structure; it does not automatically solve recognition or spatial relations.

text.zh_cn: 法杖把已测试的画布存入 WAND_CONTENTS，并按 WandLayout 把画布投影到多个平面。默认布局有 1 格和 1.5 格两个投影面。
text.en_us: The wand stores tested canvases in WAND_CONTENTS and projects them onto multiple planes using WandLayout. The default layout has planes at 1 and 1.5 blocks.

items.zh_cn: Shift+右键打开配置界面，槽位里的画布会被复制进法杖数据。
items.en_us: Shift+right-click opens configuration; canvases in slots are copied into wand data.

items.zh_cn: 按住右键创建投影实体，松开后 WandProjectionService 停止投影。
items.en_us: Hold right-click to create projection entities; release to stop through WandProjectionService.

items.zh_cn: 投影是渲染与编译复用，不会把原画布从世界中删除。
items.en_us: Projection reuses rendering and compiled data; it does not delete the source canvas.

text.zh_cn: 先从最底层检查，而不是立刻修改模板。识别不到通常意味着像素没有 mana 效果、笔画不连通、符文粘连或表面方向导致形状变形。
text.en_us: Check the lowest layer first instead of immediately changing templates. No glyph usually means missing mana effects, disconnected strokes, touching glyphs, or a surface orientation that distorts the shape.

items.zh_cn: 确认副手是带 gyromancy:mana_ink 的墨水瓶，并且墨水未耗尽。
items.en_us: Confirm the offhand contains gyromancy:mana_ink and is not empty.

items.zh_cn: 用 Debug Brush 只画单点，验证画布是否能接收效果层。
items.en_us: Use Debug Brush dots to verify that the canvas accepts effect layers.

items.zh_cn: 把每个符文分开画，避免 flood fill 把多个符文合成一个组件。
items.en_us: Separate glyphs so flood fill does not merge them into one component.

items.zh_cn: 查看客户端 glyph overlay 和服务端日志中的 confidence。
items.en_us: Check the client glyph overlay and confidence values in the server log.

title.en_us: Glyphs exist, array does not form

text.zh_cn: 这说明识别阶段通过，但空间验证或编译阶段失败。法阵必须有一个外环，且外环内部恰好一个中心符文；参数和子法阵必须落在正确的边界内。
text.en_us: This means recognition passed but spatial validation or compilation failed. An array needs one outer circle and exactly one center; parameters and child arrays must lie inside the correct boundary.

items.zh_cn: 两个中心符文会被拒绝，而不是随机选择一个。
items.en_us: Two centers are rejected rather than choosing one at random.

items.zh_cn: 外环太小会把参数或中心排除在外；外环嵌套时检查最近的父边界。
items.en_us: A boundary that is too small excludes inputs; with nesting, check the nearest parent boundary.

items.zh_cn: 编译失败时，查找缺少 match 输入、未消费符文和嵌套操作类型。
items.en_us: On compile failure, look for missing match inputs, unconsumed runes, and nested operation types.

text.zh_cn: 法阵注册成功不代表每个中心都有直接效果。有些中心只是语义锚点，必须和操作符文或嵌套操作组合；另一些效果只在服务端 tick、碰撞或丢弃时发生。
text.en_us: A registered array does not mean every center has a direct effect. Some centers are semantic anchors that need operation runes or nested operations; other effects happen only on server ticks, collisions, or discard.

items.zh_cn: 检查服务端是否启用 element tick，以及元素浓度是否为零。
items.en_us: Check that element ticks are enabled and concentrations are not zero.

items.zh_cn: 投射实体存在但看不见时，检查客户端 renderer、投影面和 Photon/VFX 资源。
items.en_us: If an entity exists but is invisible, check its client renderer, projection plane, and Photon/VFX resources.

items.zh_cn: 数组破坏时观察 EndEffect 是否清理实体，避免把旧实体当成新法阵输出。
items.en_us: When an array breaks, verify EndEffect cleanup so old entities are not mistaken for new output.

items.zh_cn: 画布：右键打开；左键绘制；右键擦除；Shift 平移/缩放。
items.en_us: Canvas: right-click to open; left draws; right erases; Shift pans/zooms.

items.zh_cn: 笔：主手；魔力墨水副手；按住使用键绘制。
items.en_us: Pen: main hand; mana ink offhand; hold use to paint.

items.zh_cn: 圆规：Shift+滚轮调半径；按住右键转动视角绘制。
items.en_us: Compass: Shift+scroll changes radius; hold right-click and turn to draw.

items.zh_cn: 印章：Shift+右键编辑；R 旋转；X+拖动缩放。
items.en_us: Stamp: Shift+right-click edits; R rotates; X+drag resizes.

items.zh_cn: 法杖：Shift+右键配置；按住右键投影。
items.en_us: Wand: Shift+right-click configures; hold right-click to project.

caption.zh_cn: 法杖界面素材 / Wand UI
caption.en_us: 法杖界面素材 / Wand UI

text.zh_cn: 游戏内手册解释的是本模组当前实现；NeoForge、Painter 和 Minecraft 本体的通用 API 可能随版本变化。需要扩展模组时，先阅读本手册对应章节，再查看外部文档。
text.en_us: This manual describes the current mod implementation. General NeoForge, Painter, and Minecraft APIs can change between versions. When extending the mod, read the matching chapter first, then consult external documentation.
